description: This file declares the SetupElement class, which is a task for setting up a GStreamer element within the Rialto media server. It includes class members for context, wrappers, and the GStreamer element, and defines the execute method.

classes.name: SetupElement
classes.description: A class representing a task to set up a GStreamer element within the Rialto media server, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: SetupElement
methods.description: Constructor initializing the setup task with context, wrappers, player, and GStreamer element.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the setup task for the GStreamer element.
